result.instructions: CashLeak helps businesses identify recurring spend worth reviewing. It is not accounting or tax advice.

tools.name: classify_spend_leak
tools.description: Triage one recurring business spend item for under-use, overlap, price increase, ownership gaps, and business criticality. Returns annualized cost, estimated under-utilized spend and review priority.
tools.title: classify spend leak

positive.prompt:
This tool costs $1,000/month, usage is 10%, overlap 90, essentiality 10, and no owner is known.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"essentiality": 10, "monthly_cost": 1000, "overlap_score": 90, "owner_known": false, "utilization_percent": 10}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
